record.title: Kosovo closes land admission to foreign travellers in the first pandemic wave
record.scope: Land entry prohibition; includes Kosovo–Serbia disputed-status boundary
record.crossings: Reopening scope: Merdare, Vërmicë, Kullë, Hani i Elezit, Jarinje and Dheu i Bardhë
record.exceptions: Kosovo citizens could return subject initially to 14-day isolation. June monitoring records international freight permission; uninterrupted freight access from March is not established. At easing, recent PCR or seven-day isolation applied.
record.enforcement: Binding government order and border-management operational notice; six-post reopening reported by regional transport monitoring.
record.consequences: Ordinary foreign passenger entry restricted; goods movement separately preserved.
record.relationship: Separate public-health restriction from later Kosovo–Serbia political blockades and goods restrictions; reciprocal neighbouring orders remain distinct.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Contain COVID-19 following the first confirmed cases.
record.context: Government decision of 13 March was operationally notified for 14 March; a 31 May repeal preceded the reported six-post opening on 1 June.
record.uncertainty: Original page header misdates the 13 March decision as 12 March. Reopening evidence is an operational monitoring update, not direct observation of first vehicles at each post; report retains a stale closure sentence. No full-post or uninterrupted interval inferred.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. No numerical duration: scope narrowed to six reopened posts, citizen/freight exceptions persisted and complete continuity is not established.
